title: Digital Remote Monitoring of Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy Induced Toxicity Using the Vigilant App
official: Digital Remote Monitoring of Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy Induced Toxicity: A Feasibility Study of the Vigilant App (Vigilant-2)
summary: This study is being done to better understand patient experiences with using a mobile application, known as Vigilant, to monitor symptoms as outpatients and to gather preliminary data on the potential clinical benefit to remote monitoring of adverse events.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any skin cancer/melanoma patient starting dual \[ipilimumab/nivolumab (IPI/NIVO)\] immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Does not meet inclusion criteria
